summary.zh: 本课聚焦 PTE Academic Write From Dictation（WFD）中高频出现的句型结构，帮助中国考生识别并准确拼写听到的完整句子。WFD 句子通常不复杂，但常包含 academic noun phrases、passive voice、prepositional phrases、relative clauses、there be 结构、modal verbs、并列结构以及抽象名词搭配。掌握这些结构可以提升听辨速度、语法预测能力和书写准确率，同时也能迁移到 IELTS Listening、Writing 和 Speaking 中。

structure.formula: Subject + Verb + Object/Complement + Modifier；There be + Noun Phrase + Prepositional Phrase；Subject + Passive Verb + by/for/in + Noun Phrase；Noun Phrase + Relative Clause + Main Verb；Modal Verb + Base Verb + Object
structure.explanation: WFD 的核心不是创造句子，而是在短时间内准确还原听到的句子。考生需要通过语法框架预测句子走向。例如，听到 The lecture was 时，应立即判断后面可能接 passive participle、adjective complement 或 prepositional phrase；听到 There are several 时，应预判复数名词；听到 Students should 时，应使用动词原形。中国考生常因忽略冠词、复数、介词和被动语态而失分，因此必须把语法结构、词汇搭配和声音信号结合起来记忆。

examples.en: The results of the experiment were published in a scientific journal.
examples.zh: 实验结果发表在一本科学期刊上。

examples.en: There are several important factors affecting climate change.
examples.zh: 有几个重要因素正在影响气候变化。

examples.en: Students should submit their assignments before the deadline.
examples.zh: 学生应该在截止日期前提交作业。

examples.en: The policy that was introduced last year has been widely discussed.
examples.zh: 去年推出的政策已经被广泛讨论。

usage_scenarios.title: 名词短语作主语
usage_scenarios.description: WFD 中经常以较长的 noun phrase 开头，例如 The impact of technology、The development of new policies、A significant number of students。听到开头后，要快速判断中心名词的单复数，并决定后面的动词形式。

examples.en: The impact of social media on communication is widely debated.
examples.zh: 社交媒体对交流的影响被广泛讨论。

examples.en: A significant number of students have difficulty managing their time.
examples.zh: 相当多的学生在时间管理方面有困难。

usage_scenarios.title: 被动语态结构
usage_scenarios.description: PTE WFD 高频使用 passive voice，因为学术英语强调研究、结果、政策和过程，而不是动作执行者。听到 was、were、is、are、has been、have been 时，要预判过去分词。

examples.en: The final report was submitted to the department yesterday.
examples.zh: 最终报告昨天已提交给该部门。

examples.en: New regulations have been introduced to improve public safety.
examples.zh: 新的规定已经被引入，以提升公共安全。

usage_scenarios.title: There be 句型
usage_scenarios.description: There be 结构常用于引出某种现象、数量、问题或证据。考生要注意 be 动词与后面真正主语的一致关系，例如 There is evidence 和 There are several reasons。

examples.en: There is strong evidence to support this argument.
examples.zh: 有强有力的证据支持这一论点。

examples.en: There are many opportunities for students to develop practical skills.
examples.zh: 学生有很多机会发展实践技能。

usage_scenarios.title: 介词短语作修饰语
usage_scenarios.description: WFD 句子常在句末加入 prepositional phrases，例如 in the library、for further research、on campus、during the semester。介词通常弱读，容易被中国考生漏写。

examples.en: The books are available in the main library.
examples.zh: 这些书可以在主图书馆找到。

examples.en: The data will be used for further research.
examples.zh: 这些数据将被用于进一步研究。

usage_scenarios.title: 情态动词加动词原形
usage_scenarios.description: WFD 中常见 should、must、can、could、may、might、will、would。情态动词后必须接 base verb，不加 to，不加第三人称单数。

examples.en: Researchers should consider the limitations of the study.
examples.zh: 研究人员应该考虑该研究的局限性。

examples.en: Students can access the online materials through the university website.
examples.zh: 学生可以通过大学网站访问在线资料。

usage_scenarios.title: 定语从句
usage_scenarios.description: 定语从句在 WFD 中用于补充说明名词，常见关系词包括 which、that、who、where。听到名词后若出现短暂停顿或关系词，应判断后面是 relative clause，而不是新的完整句。

examples.en: The students who attended the workshop received certificates.
examples.zh: 参加研讨会的学生获得了证书。

examples.en: The theory that explains this phenomenon is still controversial.
examples.zh: 解释这一现象的理论仍然存在争议。

usage_scenarios.title: 并列结构
usage_scenarios.description: WFD 经常使用 and、but、or 连接并列名词、动词、形容词或句子。考生需要保持平行结构，例如 reading and writing、clear and concise、collect and analyze data。

examples.en: Students are expected to read widely and write critically.
examples.zh: 学生被期望广泛阅读并进行批判性写作。

examples.en: The course is challenging but highly rewarding.
examples.zh: 这门课程具有挑战性，但回报很高。

common_mistakes.wrong: The result of the experiments were published.
common_mistakes.correct: The results of the experiments were published.
common_mistakes.explanation: were 表明主语应为复数。中国考生常只听到 result 的音而忽略复数 -s，导致 subject-verb agreement 错误。

common_mistakes.wrong: Students should to submit their assignments.
common_mistakes.explanation: 情态动词 should 后接动词原形，不能加 to。WFD 中听到 should 后要立即锁定 base verb。

common_mistakes.wrong: There are strong evidence to support the claim.
common_mistakes.correct: There is strong evidence to support the claim.
common_mistakes.explanation: evidence 是不可数名词，there be 中 be 动词要与 evidence 保持一致，因此使用 is。

common_mistakes.wrong: The lecture was discuss in the seminar.
common_mistakes.correct: The lecture was discussed in the seminar.
common_mistakes.explanation: was 后若表示被动，应接过去分词 discussed。中国考生容易把过去式和过去分词听成原形。
information 是不可数名词，不能用 are。PTE 中不可数名词常作为主语出现，必须使用单数动词。

common_mistakes.wrong: The university provide many resources for students.
common_mistakes.correct: The university provides many resources for students.
common_mistakes.explanation: The university 是第三人称单数主语，一般现在时动词需要加 -s。WFD 评分会识别单词形式错误。

common_mistakes.wrong: Researchers need collect more reliable data.
common_mistakes.correct: Researchers need to collect more reliable data.
common_mistakes.explanation: need 作实义动词时后接 to-infinitive。不要把 need 与 must、should 等情态动词混淆。

common_mistakes.wrong: The policy introduced last year have changed.
common_mistakes.correct: The policy introduced last year has changed.
common_mistakes.explanation: introduced last year 是过去分词短语修饰 policy，真正主语是单数 policy，因此谓语应为 has changed。

common_mistakes.wrong: The students who attends the lecture will receive credit.
common_mistakes.correct: The students who attend the lecture will receive credit.
common_mistakes.explanation: who 指代复数 students，因此定语从句中的动词应使用 attend，而不是 attends。

common_mistakes.wrong: The research focuses in environmental issues.
common_mistakes.correct: The research focuses on environmental issues.
common_mistakes.explanation: focus on 是固定搭配，不能用 focus in。WFD 中介词弱读，但仍必须准确书写。

pte_usage.description: WFD 是 PTE Listening 中对总分影响非常大的题型，句子通常来自校园、学术研究、课程安排、政策规定、图书馆资源和社会科学话题。高分考生不只依赖听力记忆，还会利用语法预测来补全弱读词、功能词和词尾变化。常考语法包括 noun phrases、subject-verb agreement、articles、plural nouns、passive voice、prepositions、relative clauses、modal verbs、perfect tense 和 parallel structure。
sections: IELTS Writing Task 2 academic sentence building

academic_patterns.pattern: The results of the study suggest that + clause.
There is increasing evidence that + clause.
Students are required to + base verb.
The lecture will focus on + noun phrase.
It is important to consider + noun phrase.
The data have been collected from + source.
This approach can be used to + base verb.
A number of factors contribute to + noun phrase.
The issue has been widely discussed in + field.
academic_patterns.translation: 该问题已在……领域被广泛讨论。

academic_patterns.pattern: Further research is needed to + base verb.
The relationship between A and B is complex.
academic_patterns.translation: A 与 B 之间的关系很复杂。

academic_patterns.pattern: Participants were asked to + base verb.

ai_tips: 听到句子开头后，先判断主语是单数、复数还是不可数名词，再决定动词形式。
记录 WFD 时优先写实义词，如 nouns、main verbs、adjectives，再根据语法补全 articles、prepositions 和 auxiliaries。
遇到 was、were、has been、have been 时，要检查后面是否需要过去分词，避免把被动语态写成主动结构。
对常见学术搭配进行整块记忆，例如 conduct research、submit assignments、provide evidence，这比逐词记忆更稳定。
句末介词短语容易被弱读，要特别留意 in、on、at、for、to、with、from 等短小功能词。
写完后用语法反查句子：主谓是否一致、名词是否需要复数、情态动词后是否为原形、介词搭配是否自然。

practice_questions.question: 根据 WFD 高频结构补全句子：The results of the experiment ___ published in a scientific journal.
practice_questions.answer: The results of the experiment were published in a scientific journal.

practice_questions.question: 纠正句子错误：Students should to complete the online form before Friday.
practice_questions.answer: Students should complete the online form before Friday.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确 be 动词：There ___ strong evidence to support this theory.
practice_questions.answer: There is strong evidence to support this theory.

practice_questions.question: 根据中文写出英文句子：学生必须在截止日期前提交最终报告。
practice_questions.answer: Students must submit the final report before the deadline.

practice_questions.question: 纠正句子错误：The information are available on the university website.
practice_questions.answer: The information is available on the university website.

practice_questions.question: 补全被动语态句子：New policies have been ___ to improve public health.
practice_questions.answer: New policies have been introduced to improve public health.

practice_questions.question: 根据提示组成完整句子：The lecture / focus on / environmental issues.
practice_questions.answer: The lecture will focus on environmental issues.

practice_questions.question: 纠正主谓一致错误：A number of students has applied for the scholarship.
practice_questions.answer: A number of students have applied for the scholarship.

practice_questions.question: 补全学术句型：Further research is needed ___ the long-term effects.
practice_questions.answer: Further research is needed to examine the long-term effects.

practice_questions.question: 根据 WFD 逻辑补全句子：The students who attended the workshop ___ certificates.
practice_questions.answer: The students who attended the workshop received certificates.
